Note: Enrolled in Master’s Degree or MBA program graduating in December 2027 or Spring 2028 (Business Analytics, Data Science, Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field)


Job Description:
This internship provides an opportunity to gain hands-on experience in operations, data analysis, and logistics. The intern will turn data from the company's distribution centers, parcel carriers and direct-to-consumer fulfillment operations into reporting and insights that improve productivity and reduce cost, and will help the team adopt AI tools in its day-to-day analysis and reporting. The internship takes place in Summer.


Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

- Collect, clean, and analyze datasets from logistics operations, including transportation, parcel shipping, distribution center productivity, inventory, and direct-to-consumer fulfillment costs.
- Build and automate recurring reporting - dashboards, monthly cost and KPI reports, and executive-ready summaries - so the team spends less time assembling data and more time acting on it.
- Identify trends, anomalies, and cost drivers (for example carrier rates and surcharges, labor productivity, inventory health) and turn them into data-backed recommendations.
- Map the team’s recurring analyses and manual workflows, prioritize where AI and automation add the most value, and pilot one or more solutions end to end.
- Prototype AI-assisted tools, such as draft commentary for monthly performance reports, anomaly flagging on freight and labor data, and summarization of operating documents and carrier agreements.
- Improve data readiness for analytics and AI: standardize metric definitions, document data sources (warehouse, transportation, carrier, and finance systems), and set up repeatable data pipelines.
- Document solutions, build how-to and prompt guides, train colleagues, and measure adoption and time saved so improvements outlast the internship.
- Present findings and recommendations to Global Logistics leadership and bring relevant AI and analytics practices from the industry to the team.


Required Qualifications:

- Enrolled in Master’s Degree or MBA program graduating in December 2027 or Spring 2028 (Business Analytics, Data Science, Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field preferred).
- 1-3 years related job experience.
- Hands-on experience in data analysis or analytics engineering, preferably in the logistics, supply chain, or operations domain.
- Proficiency in SQL, Python (pandas or similar), and advanced Excel; experience working with data from ERP, warehouse management, or transportation management systems is a plus.
- Strong data visualization skills using tools like Tableau, Power BI, or similar.
- Working knowledge of generative AI tools (for example ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, or similar), including prompt design, and experience applying them to real analysis or automation tasks; exposure to LLM APIs or workflow automation tools is a plus.
- Knowledge of logistics and supply chain concepts and processes.
- Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail, including sound judgment on data quality and the limits of AI-generated output.
- Effective communication skills to convey complex data findings to non-technical stakeholders.
- Self-starter, eager to learn and organized.


Compensation:
The compensation for this role is $24 per hour.
